body.description: Beeplet: a round ceiling smoke detector creature, white disc body with vent slits, one small red blinking light eye, tiny legs, alarmed nervous expression, a little speaker grille mouth. a small living machine creature (an Ohm), an old household or farm machine that woke up with a will of its own, weathered by years outdoors, no humans, no rider
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
